elements.text: Informing flight crews of potential restricted rudder control and mitigations would help prevent undesired rudder input
FAA issued Airworthiness Directive 2024-03-04 regarding missing nut/washer and migrated bolt in aft rudder quadrant
AD stated loss of rudder control via pedals would result in position based only on trim and yaw damper
AD stated limited rudder trim authority would not be enough to counter engine-out or high crosswind scenarios
AD stated this condition could result in loss of continued safe flight and landing
Removal of Collins Aerospace SVO-730 actuators with incorrectly assembled bearings would eliminate a potential cause of restricted rudder control
Recommendation to Boeing to instruct operators to notify crews about potential jamming due to moisture accumulation and freezing
Recommendation to Boeing to determine appropriate flight crew responses besides maximum rudder pedal force
Recommendation to FAA to determine if actuators with incorrectly assembled bearings should be removed
Recommendation to FAA to notify international regulators about safety issues and encourage removal
